VideoPress for OBS: manual installation (Linux)
===============================================

This archive is an alternative to the .deb package, for installing into your own OBS
configuration without root. It needs OBS Studio 31.1 or later installed from your
distribution or the OBS PPA, built against the same Qt 6 and libobs as Ubuntu 24.04.
(The Flatpak build of OBS uses its own runtime and is not supported by this archive.)

1. Quit OBS Studio.
2. Extract the archive (it contains a single "obs-videopress" folder) into:

       ~/.config/obs-studio/plugins/

   For example:
       mkdir -p ~/.config/obs-studio/plugins
       tar -xJf obs-videopress-*-portable.tar.xz -C ~/.config/obs-studio/plugins

   You should end up with:
       ~/.config/obs-studio/plugins/obs-videopress/bin/64bit/obs-videopress.so
       ~/.config/obs-studio/plugins/obs-videopress/data/...

3. Start OBS Studio. The VideoPress dock is under Docks -> VideoPress.

To uninstall, quit OBS and delete ~/.config/obs-studio/plugins/obs-videopress.
